reviews.author: CinemaSerf
reviews.content: When dad “Chris” (Scott Eastwood) and her aunt “Jenny” (Willa Fitzgerald) are killed in a car accident, the young “Clara” (Mckenna Grace) finds her relationship with her now widowed mum (Allison Williams) becoming a bit strained. This might also be because she has recently started seeing local school heart-throb “Miller” (Mason Thames) who already has a girlfriend and so might just be a bit one-track minded? Also on her radar is her mother’s long term friend “Jonah” (Dave Franco) who was married to “Jenny” and so is now also grieving as he attempts to bring up his newborn baby. “Jonah” happens on some clues that explain, pretty uncomfortably, just why their respective spouses were in the same car and that changes their dynamic, a change they decide to keep from the young “Clara”. What chance they can keep their bombshell to themselves though - especially as their own relationship is looking like it is about to enliven? With the scene set, we focus mainly on the two teenagers and it becomes something shockingly cheesy. There’s way, way, too much dialogue and with Franco largely sidelined it becomes one of those predictable family melodramas that never really addresses any of the elephants on the room; takes a fairly cavalier attitude to grief and makes very little attempt to add depth to any of it’s principle characters especially that of “Miller” (whose closing scene creeped me out a little, too). It looks good, but is insubstantial fluff that ought to have gone straight to a streamer and Clancy Brown has come a long way from his time as the menacing “Kurgan” - and not in a good way, either. Regretting or forgetting? Both would seem to apply here.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Following a tragic car accident that uncovers a shocking extramarital affair, a mother and her teenage daughter must navigate grief, betrayal, and hidden secrets to rebuild their fractured relationship.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: After a sudden crash claims the lives of her husband Chris and her sister Jenny, Morgan Grant discovers the devastating secret that the two were having an affair. Trying to protect her 17-year-old daughter Clara from the painful truth, Morgan hides the betrayal, but her emotional withdrawal causes resentment to grow between them. As Clara seeks solace in a budding romance with her classmate Miller, misunderstandings compound until long-buried secrets threaten to destroy their bond. Ultimately, confronting the truth allows both mother and daughter to heal, forgive, and redefine love on their own terms.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Morgan Grant became a mother at seventeen and put her own ambitions on hold to raise her daughter Clara with her husband Chris. Seventeen years later, a sudden tragic car accident takes the lives of Chris and Morgan's younger sister, Jenny. Soon after, Morgan and Jenny's fiancé Jonah discover hidden letters and evidence proving that Chris and Jenny had been having a secret affair. Wanting to shield Clara from losing her loving memories of her father and aunt, Morgan keeps the truth to herself, but her grief and secret burden cause her relationship with Clara to deteriorate. Clara, burdened by misplaced guilt thinking a text message she sent caused the crash, acts out and turns to a romance with her classmate Miller. Misunderstandings reach a breaking point when Clara catches Morgan kissing Jonah, leading Clara to believe her mother was the unfaithful one. During a tense confrontation where Clara breaks down over her guilt, Morgan realizes the damage her secrecy has caused and finally reveals the truth about the affair. Free from her guilt, Clara reconciles with Morgan, allowing both women to process their grief, forgive the past, and embrace new romantic beginnings.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Morgan Grant and her teenage daughter Clara could not be more different: Morgan is determined to keep her daughter from repeating her youthful mistake of getting pregnant early, while Clara sees her mother as predictable and restrictive. The constant mediator in their household is Chris—Morgan's husband and Clara's beloved father. But when a tragic accident unexpectedly shatters their family, it uncovers hidden truths and deep betrayals that force both women to re-evaluate everything they knew about the people they loved. As Morgan and Clara navigate grief, family secrets, and new romantic attractions, they must learn to understand one another and rebuild their relationship from the ground up.

story_structure.climax: The unspoken secrets and pent-up resentment explode in an emotional confrontation, forcing Morgan and Clara to face the full truth of the past and the reality of their fractured relationship.

story_structure.introduction: Morgan Grant and her teenage daughter Clara live a stable but tense life in Texas, holding contrasting views on stability, young love, and family expectations.
story_structure.risingAction: Morgan struggles to keep the truth hidden to protect Clara, while Clara rebels and seeks solace in Jonah, her aunt's former fiancé. As secrets unravel, mother and daughter clash repeatedly over grief, trust, and forbidden romance.
